items.title: AI could help with early diagnosis of breast cancer
items.summary: The UK NHS has launched the EDITH trial with 700,000 women, making it the world's largest trial of AI in breast cancer screening.

items.title: Cogent Biosciences gains FDA approval for Ekitna combo in GIST
items.summary: The US FDA has approved Cogent Biosciences’ Ekitna in combination with sunitinib for adult patients with advanced GIST who previously received imatinib.

items.title: MAXONA’s MAX-001 secures FDA fast track status for non-opioid pain drug
items.summary: The US FDA has granted fast track designation (FTD) for MAXONA Pharmaceuticals’ oral therapy, MAX-001, aimed at treating acute pain.

items.title: From detecting contamination to predicting risk
items.summary: Environmental monitoring helps sterile manufacturers spot weaknesses early, protect product quality and prevent costly disruptions.

items.title: London Life Sciences Week: Dealmaking, AI, and China the talk of the town
items.summary: Included in this episode are key takeaways from several events across London Life Sciences Week, including Jeffries, London Biotech Show and the DIA-MHRA.
